why: RJ-P71, pending DS-z (suiteui/document-setup): DS-8 makes file.new take a DocumentSetup, but the PNG's pHYs (300 ppi) lands with DS-z, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. With an image open (input/open.png, which File > New replaces), a new 4 x 6 in image at 300 ppi on a transparent background, a 100 px square filled with the brush color (black: no command sets the color yet), exported as PNG. The trap: the image comes out 1920 x 1080 white, or 4 x 6 px. The assertion: the PNG is 1200 x 1800, its corner is clear and the square is opaque; the turn-on adds the pHYs check and sets platforms to linux and macos.
